title: 第1443章 刷爆他的生命第1442章 玩火自焚
slug: 被逐出宗门后师尊师姐后悔终生
content_zh:
“黄远，现在事情紧急，你来顶上！”
玄华没有丝毫的犹豫，直接吩咐道。
“什么！”
听到这话，黄远如同一条过电的土狗，差点原地起跳，出了个大洋相。
“怎么，你不愿意？”
见此情景，玄华立刻皱紧了眉头。
“身为反抗军的副首领，难道你就想这样袖手旁观，眼睁睁的看着青灵魂飞魄散吗？”
“还是说，老圣王可以舍己为人，你不可以？”
玄华字字揪心的问道，直指要害。
这并非道德绑架，自她担任首领以来，早就将生死置之度外了。
若是能够阻止天道的阴谋，能让这个世界的生灵正常运转，哪怕付出一切她也在所不惜。
这般信念，青灵也是如此，站在这里的一众反抗军的高层都是如此。
自然而然的，他们以为黄远也该是这样，毕竟对方担任副首领之时，也已经宣誓过了。
绝不抛弃任何一个伙伴，为了共同的目标甘愿粉身碎骨！
如今对方这般姿态，扭扭捏捏，顿时让在场的几人心生异感。
“不，不是的，你听我解释，这其中有原因…”
他的眼珠子飞速转动，心跳过不停，却早已暗自疯狂骂娘。
“该死该死…为什么偏偏这个时候出现意外，明明只差一步，只要搜魂阵法启动，我就可以收割了！”
面对众人审视的目光，他感到了巨大的压力。
再加上玄华散发出若有若无的敌意，一时之间，黄远的额头上都渗出了冷汗。

真发生冲突，后果将不堪设想。
虽然他隐藏了实力，但从天道那里得知，玄华的实力比他更强！
而且他的修为都是通过邪门献祭得来的，交起手来，他会被摧枯拉朽的挫败。
绝对不能露馅！
“副首领，您在犹豫什么，如果有难处的话，老夫即便燃烧精血，也可以主持阵眼！”
那个老圣王颤颤巍巍的站了起来，脸色苍白，嘴角咳血，却直接将其逼到了墙角上。
此话一出，黄远的五官都轻微的扭曲在了一起。
到了这一刻，他即便有再多的理由，再深层的隐秘后也不能拒绝了。
你特殊，难道还能特殊过一个风烛残年的老人吗？
此刻胆敢说一个不字，立刻就会暴露。
“触犯禁忌可是要出大事的，而我身为天道的奴仆，明知故犯，更是罪加一等，我可不能引火烧身！”
“办法…必须要想办法，该死，我到底要怎么办…”
“有了！”
焦急到了极限，突然间，他灵光一闪。
既然那个老东西可以凭借伤势躲过禁忌之法，那他照做不就行了。
可是想要蒙混过关，就必须要受比对方更重的伤，而且还得货真价实，不能凭表象瞒天过海。
一想到这儿，他们就忍不住肝颤。
content_en:
"Huang Yuan, the matter is urgent now, you come to take charge!"
Xuanhua gave the order directly without any hesitation.
"What!"
Hearing this, Huang Yuan was like an electrified local dog. He almost jumped up and made a big fool of himself.
"What, you don't want to?"
Seeing this scene, Xuanhua immediately frowned.
"As the deputy leader of the resistance, do you just want to stand by and watch Qing Soul disappear like this?"
"Or is it that the old Saint King can sacrifice himself for others, but you can't?"
Xuanhua asked heart-wrenchingly, pointing directly to the vital point.
This is not moral kidnapping. She has put life and death aside since she became the leader.
If she could stop the conspiracy of Heaven and allow the creatures in this world to function normally, she would not hesitate to do anything.
Qing Ling also holds this belief, as do the high-ranking officials of the resistance forces standing here.
Naturally, they thought Huang Yuan should be like this, after all, he had already sworn an oath when he became the deputy leader.
Never abandon any partner, and be willing to die for the common goal!
Now the other party's posture and coquettishness immediately made several people present feel strange.
"No, it's not. Listen to me. There is a reason for this..."
His eyes were moving rapidly, his heart was beating fast, but he was already secretly cursing his mother crazily.
"Damn it, damn it... Why does an accident happen at this time? It's obviously only one step away. As long as the soul-searching formation is activated, I can harvest it!"
Facing the scrutiny of everyone, he felt tremendous pressure.
Coupled with Xuanhua's vague hostility, cold sweat broke out on Huang Yuan's forehead for a while.
If a conflict does occur, the consequences will be disastrous.
Although he hid his strength, he learned from Tiandao that Xuanhua was stronger than him!
Moreover, his cultivation was obtained through sacrifices from evil sects. If they fight against each other, he will be severely defeated.
Absolutely no secrets!
"Deputy leader, what are you hesitating about? If there is any difficulty, I can still preside over the formation even if I burn my essence and blood!"
The old holy king stood up tremblingly, his face was pale, and he was coughing up blood at the corner of his mouth, but he was directly forced into the corner.
As soon as these words came out, Huang Yuan's facial features were slightly distorted.
At this moment, no matter how many reasons or deep secrets he had, he couldn't refuse.
You are special, how can you be more special than a dying old man?
If you dare to say no at this moment, you will be exposed immediately.
"Breaking a taboo will lead to serious consequences, and as a slave of heaven, if I knowingly and intentionally break it, it will be an even greater crime. I can't let myself get burned!"
"A way... I have to find a way, damn, what on earth am I going to do..."
"Yes!"
His anxiety reached its limit, and suddenly, he had a flash of inspiration.
Since the old guy can escape the forbidden method by relying on his injuries, then he can just do it.
But if you want to get away with it, you have to be injured more seriously than the opponent, and you have to be genuine, and you can't rely on appearances to hide the truth.
When they thought of this, they couldn't help but feel their livers tremble.
